details.title: Bebop dominant scales
details.lead: Mixolydian with the major 7th added as a passing note, so the chord tones fall on the beats. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
